title: The Glass House

services.name: Site Rental
services.desc: Book a private event to be held at the Glass House. Your event will include a tour of five Johnson-designed structures including the Library and the collection of paintings and sculpture. Events at the Glass House can be customized to suit your personal and/or corporate needs. - $10,000 - Reception outside of the Glass House for up to 30 people - $15,000 - Reception inside the Glass House for up to 20 people - $25,000 - Seated meal inside the Glass House at Philip Johnson’s table for up to 12 people - Includes private behind the scenes tour of the Glass House site - Cost of food, beverages and rentals not included - 3 hour maximum - Dates and times based on availability, prime dates

blurb: The Glass House, built between 1949 and 1995 by architect Philip Johnson, is a National Trust Historic Site located in New Canaan, Connecticut.
